    Gibbs sampling dispatcher for post-SCM models

    gibbs_postscm.Rd

    Runs an appropriate Gibbs sampler depending on the complexity level encoded in gdata$cov.

    gibbs_postscm(
  gdata,
  n_iter = 1000,
  burn_in = 500,
  run_selection_gibbs = FALSE,
  do.CF = TRUE,
  selection.method = c("2SRI", "GR"),
  Z_cov_dense = FALSE,
  CF.interactions = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    gdata

    Output from prepare_data_general().

    n_iter

    Number of iterations.

    burn_in

    Burn-in iterations.

    run_selection_gibbs

    Logical; run selection equation Gibbs block (only relevant for full sampler).

    do.CF

    Use control function when IV blocks exist.

    selection.method

    Character; "2SRI" or "GR" (only relevant if run_selection_gibbs=TRUE).

    Z_cov_dense

    Dense covariance for IV first stage (requires MCMCpack if TRUE).

    CF.interactions

    Expand CF residual interactions.

    Value

    Posterior draws.
